notes.title: Gameplay Stream of EXPOSURE, a game of camouflage
notes.notes:
Tune in to see some gameplay footage of EXPOSURE, a game of camouflage -- a stylish stealth dodge 'em up. 

EXPOSURE is a game of camouflage where you can’t see yourself. Change colors to hide, dodge predators, and survive intense bosses in the abstract wilderness of stealth non-bullet hell. Lose the ability to see where you are, and learn to feel and know where you’re going.

It's like a chill pacifist stealth Ikaruga. 

Add to your wishlist and play the demo!

notes.title: New demo available for the Steam Game Festival: Autumn Edition!
notes.notes:
A new demo of [b]EXPOSURE, a game of camouflage[/b] is available as part of the Steam Game Festival.

EXPOSURE is a game of camouflage where you can’t see yourself. Change colors to hide, dodge predators, and survive intense bosses in the abstract wilderness of stealth non-bullet hell. Lose the ability to see where you are, and learn to feel and know where you’re going.

Being out in the open is unsafe. Avoid detection to survive. Switch between light and dark forms to camouflage, but careful: you won’t be able to see yourself either.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Five cool games I played at PAX East 2019
notes.notes:
As you may have surmised from a bunch of very non-hardware-related interviews I’ve done recently about the likes of the excellent Nowhere Prophet, Sparklite, Unrailed, the return of Super Meat Boy and what’s next for Astroneer, I was packed off to PAX East a couple of months ago. I was mostly there to host a panel about the best video game weapon of all time (the winner was the Portal Gun inside Hitman 2’s homing briefcase, in case you were wondering), but I also got to play a bunch of cool games as well. Here are five of my absolute favs.
